thread:
alex_csr: FYI customer AcmeAnalytics reports embeddings API started returning 403 in prod ~1h ago. Generation endpoints still succeed. They say this coincided with an IdP rotation. Minimal repro below.

alex_csr: curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings\" -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}'
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\",\"message\":\"missing: embeddings\"}

maria_support: thanks. tenant id + request id? any recent key rotations or did they mint via SSO/SCIM? :eyes:

alex_csr: tenant: acme-analytics-prod, request id: req_0adf3b9a. Key was created by their Okta integration last week during onboarding. They rotated the IdP cert this morning.

ben_infra: quick ask — can you paste the raw Authorization header (redacted token ok) and the token claims (base64 decode) so we can see scope shape? sometimes the provisioner writes an alias like \"embed\" instead of \"embeddings\".

alex_csr: pasted request headers from customer (sanitized):

Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJ...REDACTED...eyJzY29wZXMiOiJpbmZlcmVuY2UsIGVtYmVkIiwgInR5cGUiOiJzZXJ2aWNlIn0

ella_research: can you decode the payload quickly? run: 
```
echo -n \"eyJzY29wZXMiOiJpbmZlcmVuY2UsIGVtYmVkIiwgInR5cGUiOiJzZXJ2aWNlIn0\" | base64 --decode | jq .
```
should show scopes claim.

alex_csr: output from decode (customer-provided):
```
{\"scopes\":\"inference, embed\", \"typ\":\"service\"}
```

ben_infra: aha. that's our culprit. provisioner wrote \"embed\" (alias) and our authz layer expects the canonical \"embeddings\" scope token. generation/inference is covered by \"inference\" so text gen works. embeddings check does exact match -> 403.

carla_escalations: escalation logged to eng-infra. tagging with priority P1 since production embeddings are blocked for this tenant and they rely on embedding pipeline for search. Adding mitigation suggestions.

ingress-bot: @eng-infra FYI svcacct scope mismatch detected for tenant acme-analytics-prod; request req_0adf3b9a.

ben_infra: short-term mitigation: we can mint a temporary API key for them via console with explicit scopes [inference, embeddings, rerank] — that will unblock. I can do that now if they approve. Long-term: patch provisioner so it normalizes common aliases (embed->embeddings, rerank->reranking?) and accept comma/space-delimited lists robustly. Also add an audit that logs non-canonical scopes.

maria_support: alex — can you ask customer to confirm they want the temp key? i'll offer the workaround and ask for OK to create it and schedule a controlled re-provisioning. include timeline for permanent fix (eng).

alex_csr: sent: \"yes please, create temp key while you patch it\". requested TTL 48h.

ben_infra: created temp key (masked) and sent via secure channel. instructed customer to rotate after 48h. Also added a one-off migration patch to map \"embed\" -> \"embeddings\" for tokens provisioned before 1768901200 to avoid further immediate issues; will roll this back post patch.

ella_research: small note for records: token payloads with boolean-ish scope flags (e.g., \"embed\" vs \"embeddings\") are a common source of auth/SDK mismatches. We'll add this to onboarding checklist for SCIM/Okta templates.

carla_escalations: eng-infra will follow up with PR link and deploy ETA. tagging postmortem once resolved. :thumbsup:

ben_infra: initial fix branch opened: https://git.redwood.ai/eng-infra/provisioner/-/merge_requests/412 (normalizes scope aliases and trims whitespace). target deploy to canary tonight, full rollout tomorrow morning.

maria_support: marking thread resolved for CS after key delivered and tenant unblocked. keeping open for eng PR/PM follow-ups.

alex_csr: customer confirmed embeddings working again after temp key. closing on CS side. thanks everyone :tada:
